cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Fluent in Nonsense
cards.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. To get your sofa off the ceiling, turn the gravity dial politely.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm losing my deposit. How do I turn politely?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Pause at each number. They dislike being passed over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Six clicked, but now the armchairs are rising.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six has invited witnesses. Apologize to the whole suite; private apologies don't count once furniture assembles.
